mainEntity.name: How do I request a moving quote?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can submit our online quote form anytime at /get-a-quote with your pickup and delivery suburbs, property type, and move date. Alternatively, call our team on 0491 704 136 during our listed hours: 7:00 am – 8:00 pm daily.

mainEntity.name: What information should I provide for an accurate quote?

acceptedAnswer.text: To give you an accurate scope, please share: your pickup and drop-off suburbs, estimated move date, property types (e.g. 2-bed house vs 3rd-floor apartment), major furniture pieces, and any access details such as stairs, steep driveways, or elevator bookings.

mainEntity.name: Do you handle complete house removals?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We handle residential moves ranging from 1-bedroom units and townhouses up to 4+ bedroom family homes across Greater Adelaide and regional South Australia.

mainEntity.name: Do you handle apartment moves with stairs or lifts?

mainEntity.name: Do you handle commercial and office moves?

acceptedAnswer.text: Office and commercial removals are listed services. Include the locations, items, access conditions and preferred timing in your enquiry.

mainEntity.name: Can I request packing assistance for our move?

mainEntity.name: Do you handle interstate moves and backloading?

acceptedAnswer.text: Interstate removals and backloading are listed services. Share your pickup and destination details to discuss route availability.

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare before moving day?

acceptedAnswer.text: If possible, list the larger items, note any stairs or lift access, and check what parking is available at both addresses. You can include these details in your quote request.

mainEntity.name: What affects the total cost of a move?

acceptedAnswer.text: Starting rates begin from $75 per 30 minutes ($150/hr) for 2 movers and a truck. Total cost depends on move size, inventory, property access, travel and additional services requested.

mainEntity.name: How do I choose between two and three movers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Starting rates are $75 / 30 min for 2 Movers + Truck and $95 / 30 min for 3 Movers + Truck. Share your inventory, access and travel details if you would like help considering a team size.
